mechanism: Prednisone may increase dronedarone levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and glucocorticoids can potentiate cardiac effects and electrolyte disturbances; dronedarone may increase prednisone metabolism via CYP3A4 induction.
action: Monitor QTc interval, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and cardiac function; consider baseline and periodic ECG monitoring; adjust corticosteroid dosing if possible to minimize immunosuppression and hypokalemia risk.
